```typescript
async function getAnalyticsSettings() {
  try {
    const config = await client.getAnalyticsConfig();
    console.log("Analytics Configuration:", config);
    return config;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching analytics config:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
async function updateFeatureFlag(flagName: string, enabled: boolean) {
  try {
    const response = await client.postRelayRMqEFlags({ [flagName]: enabled });
    console.log("Feature flag update response:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error updating feature flag:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Dashboard Helius's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Dashboard Helius data without official API access
- Automate actions on dashboard.helius.dev (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Dashboard Helius frontend uses
